original_sentence: Fully automated burger restaurants managed with minimal human oversight—where customers order at screens, pay electronically and eat food cooked and delivered by robots—are now a possibility.
translation: 由极少人工监督管理的全自动汉堡餐厅如今已成为可能：顾客在屏幕上下单、电子支付，并食用由机器人烹制和递送的食物。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: minimal human oversight 在本句中对应"最低限度人工监督"。
order at screens 在本句中对应"在屏幕上下单"。
fully automated 在本句中对应"全自动化的"。
pay electronically 在本句中对应"电子支付"。
